main.description: Get a subject's moderation history, oldest first, and for a record in one of the group's spaces, the record itself, taken down or not. Requires mod.read.

group.description: The group DID. Every method is served by the group's host and authorized against that group's roles.

subject.description: An account DID or record URI.

cid.description: If set, only this version of the record.

record.description: The subject, a record in one of the group's spaces, as the host's index holds it: given when the index holds it and the space's policy lets the caller read it, whether or not the group has taken it down.

errors.name: InvalidSubject
errors.description: The subject isn't an account, a record in this group, or a record in a public repo.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor isn't one this host gave.
